title: Medical office, patient in a wheelchair, oxygen on site

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: 6550 Mapleridge Street, the Bellaire medical building. There's smoke in the hallway in the back, it's filling up fast!

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: One of our patients is still inside, she uses a wheelchair. She was in an exam room near the storage closets.

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Any hazards we should know about?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We keep oxygen tanks in the storage closet.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I'm in the parking lot out front.
